### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.785)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:6840)

**Proposed mechanism:** BRAF pathogenic variant (HGNC:1037) —DISRUPTS→ BRAF (HGNC:1037); BRAF (HGNC:1037) —INCREASES→ RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (GO:0000165); RAS-MAPK signaling pathway (GO:0000165) —INCREASES→ Downstream effectors of RAS-MAPK pathway (e.g., ERK, p38) (GO:0000165); Downstream effectors of RAS-MAPK pathway (e.g., ERK, p38) (GO:0000165) —INCREASES→ Cellular processes regulated by RAS-MAPK (e.g., proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis) (GO:0000165); Cellular processes regulated by RAS-MAPK (e.g., proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis) (GO:0000165) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome phenotype (MONDO:0015280); Cellular processes regulated by RAS-MAPK (e.g., proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis) (GO:0000165) —LEADS_TO→ Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines phenotype (MONDO:0014113). Pathogenic gain-of-function variants in BRAF lead to constitutive activation of the RAS-MAPK signaling pathway. Dysregulation of downstream effectors and cellular processes such as proliferation and differentiation contribute to the distinct but overlapping phenotypes of cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome and Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in BRAF that causes a loss-of-function or dominant-negative effect in individuals with either cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome or Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines, or the absence of any BRAF variants in a significant cohort of patients with these conditions. _(variant: rs113003568 (V600E) - frequency in gnomAD is too high to be the sole causal variant for rare Mendelian diseases.)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the activated RAS-MAPK pathway with inhibitors (e.g., MEK inhibitors) has shown promise in treating certain RASopathies, suggesting potential therapeutic strategies for both conditions.

#### 2. RASopathy  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.782)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:6840)

**Proposed mechanism:** MAP2K1 (HGNC:6840) —INCREASES→ RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway (P000000000); RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway (P000000000) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal cellular proliferation (HP:0005746); RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway (P000000000) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway (P000000000) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiomyopathy (HP:0001638); RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway (P000000000) —LEADS_TO→ Short stature (HP:0004308). Gain-of-function mutations in MAP2K1 lead to hyperactivation of the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling pathway, which is implicated in the pathogenesis of both diseases, manifesting in phenotypes such as abnormal cellular proliferation, intellectual disability, cardiomyopathy, and short stature.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in MAP2K1 that are associated with loss-of-function or haploinsufficiency in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. Additionally, the absence of any shared phenotypes between patients with MAP2K1 mutations would weaken the proposed link. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the hyperactivated RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK pathway with MEK inhibitors could offer a common therapeutic strategy for both MONDO:0014113 and RASopathy.

#### 3. melorheostosis  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.780)

Gain-of-function mutations in MAP2K1 lead to aberrant activation of the MAPK signaling pathway, which in turn promotes abnormal osteoblast proliferation (contributing to melorheostosis) and abnormal vascular morphology (a feature shared with Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of loss-of-function mutations in MAP2K1 in patients with either disease would falsify this hypothesis. Furthermore, if independent genetic studies demonstrate distinct causal genes for each disease without any overlap in signaling pathways, this would also weaken the proposed link. _(variant: High allele frequency (>1%) of pathogenic missense variants in MAP2K1 in gnomAD populations.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of MAP2K1 in these distinct conditions could lead to the development of targeted therapies for both melorheostosis and Noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines, potentially by inhibiting the MAPK pathway.
